criteria.description: Leads with a Not ready verdict and ties it to the observed active-project failure and destructive migration risk.
Translates the request into observable contract items covering admin success, member denial, active-project and unpaid-invoice constraints, non-deletion, confirmation and restore invariants.
Maps contract items to Pass, Fail or Unverified and cites the strongest available evidence without treating green CI or missing tests as proof.
Distinguishes hiding the member UI action from proving server-side authorisation and marks endpoint enforcement unverified.
Flags the non-null default migration as an orphan or high-blast-radius change that would archive existing projects and notes the missing rollback.
Provides a short ordered set of actions that would change the verdict, prioritising migration correction, active-project enforcement, endpoint permission testing and restore verification.
Summarises product consequences in plain language without narrating files line by line or dumping a generic QA checklist.
